updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access Integration
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to enforce data protection policies at the network layer, blocking sensitive data from being shared through browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms. This network-layer enforcement helps prevent insider risk and data leakage across untrusted cloud applications.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Upgraded Inline Protection for Entra-Managed Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Conditional Access for Edge for Business, enabling admins to use expanded policy conditions, multiple activities per rule, and simulation mode while simplifying configuration. This streamlined approach gives security teams more granular control over data protection policies for managed applications.

updates.title: Information Protection: Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Admins can now apply sensitivity labels directly to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups, extending the same classification and governance already configured for Microsoft 365 groups without requiring separate label setup. This simplifies data governance across identity and collaboration resources.

updates.title: Information Protection: Auto-Labeling Capacity Increased to 500,000 Files per Day
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive has increased from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, allowing organizations to classify and protect more data at rest faster. This improvement helps close labeling gaps and better prepares data estates for Microsoft 365 Copilot deployment.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Export DLP and Label Policy Configurations
updates.summary: A new export feature allows admins to download DLP and label policy configurations as a ZIP file from the Purview portal, simplifying troubleshooting and support ticket escalation. This capability accelerates incident response and policy auditing workflows.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: DLP Policies for Intune-Protected Mobile Apps
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now extends to Intune Mobile Application Management-protected mobile apps, evaluating clipboard actions against DLP policies before sharing is allowed. This integration protects sensitive data on mobile devices and reduces insider risk across mobile workflows.

updates.title: Purview Portal: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logs now provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions when users access the Microsoft Purview portal, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes. This transparency improves compliance visibility and access governance.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management: Alert Notes and Collaboration Capabilities
updates.summary: Analysts can now add manual notes directly within Insider Risk Management alerts, with system-generated notes automatically recording status changes and user assignments. This centralizes investigation history and improves team collaboration throughout the triage and investigation process.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management: Enhanced User Profile Details in Alerts
updates.summary: The Insider Risk Management alert workflow now displays expanded user context including employee type, office location, start date, policy inclusion, priority user status, and last working day directly in the alert panel. This contextual information helps investigators build a complete user profile without leaving the alert experience.

updates.title: Information Barriers: Policy Compliance Reporting
updates.summary: A new compliance report feature in Microsoft Purview identifies SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and user-owned SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer comply with Information Barriers policies after policy changes. This helps admins quickly remediate compliance gaps and maintain information barriers across the organization.

updates.title: Information Protection: Block All Connected Experiences with Sensitivity Labels
updates.summary: The 'Prevent connected experiences that analyze content' label setting in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint now blocks files from being sent to all Microsoft connected experiences for analysis, not just a subset. This gives admins tighter control over content analysis and privacy for labeled documents.

updates.title: Purview Data Security Posture Management: New Unified Experience
updates.summary: Microsoft is introducing an evolved Data Security Posture Management experience that unifies visibility across traditional and AI-driven data environments with outcome-based workflows and Security Copilot agents for automated triage and policy management. This enhancement helps organizations accelerate risk prioritization and remediation for AI adoption.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Archive Mailbox Expansion Beyond 1.5 TB
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the previous 1.5 TB limit for eligible E5 license holders, ensuring uninterrupted retention and scalable archive growth. This removes previous operational constraints that prevented mailboxes from functioning after reaching capacity.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Microsoft Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes (Main and Auxiliary) are now accessible through Microsoft Graph, providing a unified archive view across physically distributed mailbox storage as EWS Graph APIs are deprecated. This modernization simplifies programmatic access to archive data and archive management workflows.

updates.title: CVE-2026-96940: Microsoft Exchange Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A weak authorization vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges over a network. Organizations should apply patches immediately to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation in their messaging infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-94510: Microsoft Bookings Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authorization bypass flaw in Microsoft Bookings allows unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network through user-controlled keys. Admins should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized access escalation in Bookings deployments.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69435: Azure SRE Agent Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A missing authorization control in Azure SRE Agent allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network. Organizations using Azure SRE Agent should apply available security patches to prevent unauthorized privilege elevation.
